about: Elected officials, department leaders, 2026 local candidates and local candidates since 2016 named in the site's datasets, one id per person. Names are matched on first and last name with common nicknames (Doug = Douglas, Chris = Christopher, Dave = David ...), ignoring middle initials, titles and notes in parentheses; "(D2)" style suffixes become the district field. People who appear under more than one government are listed in multi_government for checking. No other people are included.
